text: Yes, from my method the trigger should change: h1_close_above:pivot_high is a pivot break (C17), the right kind of entry; reclaim:ma_20 is a pullback buy with no pivot. But the range-top break needs volume at least 1.4x normal (C16) or it is a breakout nobody bought. Today day_vol 0.93 fails R4, coil warn gives no tight base (R3), and W/D 5.95% under the 20-bar high is not a new high. I hold OPPOSE. What clears it: pivot_high cleared on day_vol 1.40 or more.
